8) Consider the statements :
(A) A student portfolio is a purposeful collection of pieces of student work.
(B) Portfolio can encourage students to evaluate their own strengths and weaknesses.

9) Select odd one out :
(1) Portfolio can be an effective way of communicating with parents by showing concrete examples of students' work.
(2) Portfolio can empower learners to assess teacher's capabilities.
(3) Portfolio can provide a mechanism for student centred assessment.
(4) Portfolio can provide teachers and students with opportunities to reflect.
option_a: Portfolio can be an effective way of communicating with parents by showing concrete examples of students' work.
option_b: Portfolio can empower learners to assess teacher's capabilities.
option_c: Portfolio can provide a mechanism for student centred assessment.
option_d: Portfolio can provide teachers and students with opportunities to reflect.
